name: @avatark/spatial-ecology-contracts
description: Renderer-neutral contracts for Sprint 16's spatial-ecology domain: the Domain/Sector/Quadrant/Patch/Local Place hierarchy, explicit topology, PatchState, TerritoryClaim/TerritoryPressure (an aggregation over Sprint 12's own HomeRange), Route, spatial movement context, and a spatial snapshot/delta. No implementations, no renderer objects, zero franchise content.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
